verdict.rationale: Whether an email client's source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a public repository, published source code, or an open-source license for Superhuman Mail. The docs cover only proprietary product features and an MCP integration, so with no support the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
